findings.location: content.body.steps[id=s2].blocks[3].text: "Про наявність не кажемо estar: не *estaba una farmacia, а había una farmacia."
findings.description: The asterisk presents estar with an indefinite pharmacy as categorically ungrammatical. Locative estar can take indefinite subjects; the distinction concerns existential introduction versus location, not an absolute prohibition on this string.
findings.suggestion: Explain the intended existential reading with había and contrast it with a contextualized locative example such as La farmacia estaba cerca de mi casa. Remove the unconditional ungrammaticality claim.

items.reviewerAnswer: No task to solve. Expected background-description patterns include era, tenía, hacía, estaba and había.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, treatment of existential haber, locative estar and indefinite subjects (from memory).

findings.location: task.slots[id=gap-b].accepted: "había"; task.slots[id=gap-b].errors[text=hizo].

items.reviewerAnswer: Aquel verano yo tenía diez años y hacía mucho calor en el pueblo. Hizo is also possible as a summary of that summer's weather.
